description.zh: 把侧边栏变成完整工作台：文件树与编辑器、终端、Git、任务和侧边对话，每个会话独立一份。
description.en: A full sidebar workbench: file tree and editor, terminal, Git, tasks and side chat, one set per conversation.

description.zh: 用结构化工具驱动真实 Chromium：导航、语义快照、点击、表单、脚本与截图；侧边栏实时镜像画面，可随时接手操作。
description.en: Drives a real Chromium browser with structured tools — navigation, snapshots, clicks, forms, scripts and screenshots — mirrored live in the sidebar for manual takeover.

description.zh: 一只住在界面里的蓝色大肥鱼：会自己溜达、被你拖来甩去，忙时陪着你、闲时碎碎念。
description.en: A blue fish pet living inside the interface: wanders around, gets dragged about, keeps you company while you work and chats when idle.

description.zh: 改写或重试已经发出去的消息，在原位重新生成，不用重建会话。
description.en: Edit or retry an already-sent message and regenerate in place, rewinding the model context without leaving the session.

description.zh: 给系统提示加一段过程纪律，并在连续静默的工具步骤之间给出确定性提醒，让回答逐步通报进展。没有界面，只影响模型行为。
description.en: Adds a process-discipline system-prompt section and a deterministic nudge that makes the agent narrate progress between silent tool steps. No interface — it only changes model behaviour.

description.zh: 把需要 OAuth 的远程 MCP 服务器接进 DSH：在设置页里添加并登录，令牌存在本地，断线自动重连；默认带一条 SpringBrand 连接。fork 自 springbrand-lab 的同名插件（MIT）。
description.en: Connects OAuth-protected remote MCP servers to DSH: add and sign in from Settings, tokens stored locally, automatic reconnect, with a default SpringBrand connection. Forked from springbrand-lab's plugin (MIT).

description.zh: 可组合的上下文与记忆：来源与策略可插拔，自带分层记忆、自演进技能、文档与记忆空间视图；按需召回，不把上下文一次塞满。
description.en: Composable, view-based context for DSH: pluggable sources and strategies with layered memory, self-evolving skills and document/memory-space views, recalling on demand instead of filling the context up front.

description.zh: 用 iPhone / iPad 自带的 Safari 打开电脑上的 DSH Web：侧栏多一个「手机访问」入口，给出短地址和 8 位配对码，扫码即可在同一会话里接着聊；附带 Return 换行、防自动放大等触摸小补丁。不改 DSH 核心、无生产依赖，局域网或自己的 Tailscale 内直连。
description.en: Opens the DSH Web GUI from an iPhone or iPad Safari: a Mobile Access entry in the sidebar hands out a short address and an 8-digit pairing code so the phone joins the same session, plus small touch fixes such as Return for newline and no auto-zoom. No DSH core changes, no runtime dependencies, and pairing stays on your LAN or your own Tailscale.

description.zh: 把 DSH 变成一支长驻 Bot 团队：每个 Bot 是独立会话，有自己的名字、角色、指令、模型、权限预设和工作文件夹；Bot 之间能互相发消息，支持群聊（管理员先答或成员依次发言、@ 并行、组内 Goal）与跨会话记忆，长对话由上下文管家折成 checkpoint 或交接继续。
description.en: Turns DSH into a team of long-lived Bots: each Bot is its own session with a name, role, instructions, model, permission preset and working folder. Bots message each other, built-in group chats run admin-first or in member order with parallel @-mentions and a group Goal, memory spans conversations, and a context steward folds long chats into a checkpoint or hands off to a new part.
